instructions.title: Read Selina's Incoming Message
instructions.message: Open the existing Mission Control Main Operations Console and acknowledge Selina's incoming message.
instructions.guidance: Selina departed from Deimosian Outpost and is currently travelling to PHOBOSIA Outpost. Her journey will take several hours; she has not arrived.
instructions.activity: Read and acknowledge the message; no reply or waiting is required.

instructions.title: Write Your Final Expedition Log
instructions.message: At the existing Mission Control main console, write and submit your personal final expedition log.
instructions.guidance: Reflect on your observations, discoveries, experiences and mission records from SOL 1 through SOL 10. The log must be written by you.
instructions.activity: Enter and submit a non-empty personal log.

instructions.title: Prepare for Departure
instructions.message: Travel to the existing EVA preparation point in the Airlock and prepare your suit.
instructions.guidance: Use the registered EVA suit and its existing interaction. Entering the Airlock alone does not complete this step.

instructions.title: Enter the Assigned Vehicle
instructions.message: Reach the existing Terrain Rover and enter it using its normal interaction.
instructions.guidance: Use the existing assigned rover and vehicle controls.

instructions.title: Follow the Departure Route
instructions.message: Follow the visible route beam for approximately 200 metres.
instructions.guidance: The route ends at an unnamed outpost. Selina remains on her separate journey towards PHOBOSIA Outpost.
instructions.activity: Drive the route using the existing rover controller.

instructions.title: Final Departure
instructions.guidance: The cinematic plays fullscreen and completes only when playback ends.
instructions.activity: Watch the final video to completion.

constraints: Selina remains in transit from Deimosian Outpost to PHOBOSIA Outpost.
Do not name the destination of the player's departure route.
Use existing physical objects and interactions.
Do not complete the campaign before the final video ended event.
